hero.heading: Hello, I'm Emz 👋
paragraphs: I design, evolve, and improve web products, mainly for startups and SaaS companies. With more than four years of professional experience, I own features end-to-end, from the initial product need through production delivery: Rails and PostgreSQL backends, JavaScript interfaces, external integrations, and background processing.

Comfortable working in small teams with a high level of ownership, I combine product development, problem-solving, and a strong design and UX/UI sensibility. I notably designed and shipped a complex multilingual video editor from scratch, covering everything from data architecture to the user interface.

I am open to joining a product team long term or working with clients on Rails applications: evolution and maintenance, feature development, integrations, production debugging, and existing codebases.
Based in France · Remote across France, Europe, or internationally
